rationale: The Latin anchors *persistere* ("to persist, stand firm") and *instare* ("to press on, insist") both point to resolute, unyielding continuance in a position or action, matching insist.v.01 ("be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge"). The gloss context — persisting in the faith and pressing urgently (illi instabant, Lk. 23:23) — reflects firm, determined resolve rather than mere begging (importune.v.01) or asserting a truth (insist.v.03).
